proposed_fixes.title: Coordinate recovery from a locked bookmarks file in EdgeFavorite
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the plugin's watcher callback allows a sharing-violation IOException to escape while Edge writes bookmarks; its implementation and whether it is still affected have not been independently inspected.
plan: Confirm that the reported fatal event corresponds to the user's symptom and identify the installed plugin and version.
Reproduce a locked bookmarks read in a disposable profile and coordinate the callback fix with the third-party plugin maintainer.
Have the plugin handle transient read failures without crashing the host, with a bounded retry or later refresh; investigate separate package errors independently.
verification: A locked bookmarks file does not terminate Run, and favorites refresh when the file becomes available; unrelated errors are not suppressed.
